diagnosis: Two PROD-01 workers closed NO_ALLOCATION with zero authority attempts because the one allowed compact frontier read was truncated by connector/runtime rendering. The frontier was semantically bounded by candidate count but lacked a hard serialized transport envelope and carried duplicated display metadata.
intervention: Bound claim-frontier publication to 24 KB serialized JSON, stripped non-authority duplicated candidate metadata, preserved exact claim payload/source/capability fields, minified transport, added byte-budget trimming and fail-closed behavior, strengthened EFF023, and aligned the regression guard.
remaining_boundary: Fresh worker claim using the newly published bounded frontier is still needed before describing EFF023 as fully runtime-ratcheted.
